name: Wizard Mischief Maker
body:
Puns and physical humor are a mischief maker’s tools of the trade. A mischief maker delights in livening things up with laughter and shenanigans, often at the expense of another’s embarrassment. It is of little surprise that many gnomes and halfling make exceptional mischief makers.

A mischief maker has the following class features.

Special

A mischief maker must select one of the following as his arcane school: enchantment, illusion, or transmutation.

Furthermore, a mischief maker cannot select any of the other schools as his opposition schools.

This, in conjunction with frivolity, alters arcane school.

Frivolity (Sp)

Frivolity reflects a mischief maker’s light hearted nature and ability to alter course with changing circumstances, allowing him to make spell and spell-like ability substitutions in two different ways.

First, frivolity allows a mischief maker to substitute its spell-like effects for the spell-like effects of his dazing touch, blinding ray, or telekinetic fist ability (depending upon which arcane school he selected). A mischief maker can make this substitution 1 time per day at 1st level, and one additional time per day at 10th level. By succeeding at a ranged touch attack against a creature within 30 feet, a mischief maker can cause the creature to drop its hand held items and exude peals of laughter for 1 round. An affected creature is not considered helpless, but can take no actions other than laughing. Creatures with more Hit Dice than the mischief maker’s level merely smirk and chuckle as they recall a humorous situation, suffering a -1 penalty to their armor class instead. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Second, at 1st level, a mischief maker adds his choice of two of the following spells to his spellbook: confusion, lesser, disguise self, fumbletongue, touch of gracelessness, and vanish. These spells are in addition to the normal number of spells he can select for his book. A mischief maker can spontaneously “lose” his prepared 1st level specialty school spell to cast one of these spells instead.

This alters arcane school.

Capering Caster (Ex)

A mischief maker’s history of impromptu jigs and entertaining acrobatic antics have accustomed him to constant movement, granting him a third option for his arcane bond; he can funnel his magical ability through his tumbling and gymnastic prowess. At 1st level, a mischief maker selecting this option for his arcane bond is affected in three ways.

First, he gains a +2 bonus on Acrobatics skill checks, Acrobatics becomes a class skill, and he treats the DC of Acrobatics checks to move at full speed as 5 less than normal. At 10th level, the bonus on Acrobatics skill checks increases to +4.

Second, he subtracts 5 from the DC of concentration checks made in response to vigorous, violent, or extremely violent motion.

Third, he gains a +1 Dodge bonus to AC and a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws. These bonuses increase to +2 at 10th level.

This alters arcane bond.

Comedic Timing (Ex)

At 1st level, a mischief maker adds his Intelligence modifier on initiative checks, in addition to his Dexterity modifier.

This replaces scribe scroll.

Pranks (Su)

Beginning at 5th level, a mischief maker gains the ability to use a limited selection of witch hexes. At any level a mischief maker gains a bonus feat, he can choose either a bonus feat or one of the following hexes: disguise, misfortune, natural disaster (must be 20th level to select), prehensile hair, slumber, waxen image (must be 10th level to select).

This alters bonus feats.
